ValidationRule.description: An opportunity cannot be moved past Qualification until Selling Company and Territory are filled in. Only fires when someone changes the stage on an existing record, so opportunities created by the API at a later stage are unaffected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Qualification")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(RLM_Selling_Company__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(RLM_Territory__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Selling Company and Territory before moving this opportunity past Qualification.
